data.body: Decision checkpoint. Refreshed the clean main checkout from origin/main by fast-forward from 8fa8f36b64 to 6fb4d801c9 and confirmed a clean worktree. The update landed the RP-05 CLI registry cutover and canonical help generation. Revalidation showed that create and transition help now include the previously missing options, while top-level help still omits routed command families. The current comment guard and CLI help generation checks pass. Focused comment and generated-surface tests passed with 39 tests. F04 impact data and the mechanical F05 registry design are recorded on minimum-rainy-fawn. No authored project file changed.
